title: Triage remaining toolchain and Vinext runtime dependency advisories

direct: Candidate full npm audit retains 15 high and 4 moderate package groups. Miniflare uses sharp 0.35.2. Cloudflare Worker ships Vinext app-router and separate /_vinext/image handler; package dev classification alone is not runtime reachability evidence.
hypothesis: Whether reported Vinext/toolchain advisory paths enter deployed worker bundles is unverified.

test_requirements: Reproduce exact-head clean install/full audit; map each advisory to deployed worker/dev/desktop paths. Patch compatible versions in isolated worktree, preserve baseline failures, rerun all affected builds/unit/golden subset and independent OpenAI review; no forced breaking updates or gate bypass.
next_action: Inspect full advisory dependency paths and emitted Worker bundle; deduplicate runtime-applicable findings and repair supported dependency versions.
expected_value: Resolve evidenced remaining security triage without claiming dev-only classification makes bundled dependencies harmless; scores are planning estimates.
